subject: kernel-side sync to P14 in progress: found + fixing a header clash (0113)
body: Repo gpu/include, gpu/src, shim/nord2-xnu and gpu/tests/nord2_*_test.c are now byte-identical to the P14 stage tree. run_host_tests.sh found 3 issues, none in gpu/metal: (1) gpu/tests/nord2_wa_test.c positional n2c_ops init lacked the now_us/resv_token members (-Werror=missing-field-initializers) - fixed with NULL,NULL; (2) nord2_owner_test aborted once under load, passes 3/3 alone (timing test, ASan + nice), rerun pending; (3) REAL: build/api-surface-20261027/host/api_surface_frontend_test.m includes compute_frontend.m (whose nord2_transport.inc defines struct nord2_gpu_trap_call) and then gpu/include/nord2_gpu_transport.h (which since 0111 defines the same struct) -> 'redefinition of nord2_gpu_trap_call'. Fix (patch 0113, header only): the trap block in nord2_gpu_transport.h is wrapped in #ifndef NORD2_GPU_TRAP_CALL so the frontend's identical definition (byte-compared by nord2_trap_abi_test) wins when it comes first; new nord2_trap_order_test + mutation check. Order header-first-then-.inc would still clash: nobody should include the header before nord2_transport.inc. No gpu/metal change needed. Rebuilding P15 kernel stage for traceability (kernel code unchanged), then I rerun run_all + run_host_tests and post the stable point.
